decision.summary: A correlated negative transient in N and E begins at index 495, peaks near 510–515, with U lagging and smaller. Recovery initiates around 516–517 but remains incomplete within allowed context [460,555]; thus the interval is uncertain. No other temporary offsets are supported in this region.

A partial recovery begins around 516–517 on N/E, but the return is not yet complete or unambiguous by index 517; no opposing return observed in U. Status: uncertain due to incomplete resolution of return.
